uncovered_waiver.reason: OMN-14802 is a hand-authored def-B dispatch-entrypoint conversion for an existing projection node. Coverage is structurally below the generic compute-node target because the handler module includes three event models, timestamp/default branches, and backward-compat project() wrappers while the selected set is intentionally the dispatch/parity set from tests/test_golden_chain_projection_overnight.py: session-start, phase-end, and session-complete through handle() with injected DatabaseAdapter. The same PR preserves the existing project(event, db) golden-chain unit tests unmodified, adds RuntimeLocal dispatch proof, and reads rows back from the injected in-memory adapter, so the waiver is scoped to adequacy measurement rather than behavior proof.
